question.problem:
$$
{f}_{X\,|\,Y}(x\,|\,3)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{3{x}^{2}}{8}, & \,\,0\le x\le 2 \\ 0, & \,\,\text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

 

Let $X$ and $Y$ be continuous random variables. 
Find the conditional expected value $\text{E}[X\,|\,Y=3]$ given that the conditional probability density function ${f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,3)$ is shown above.
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional expected value of $X$ given $Y=y$ is defined by

$$
\text{E}[X\,|\,Y=y]={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }x\,{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,y)\,\text{d}x.
$$

Therefore, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X\,|\,Y=3] & ={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }x\,{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,3)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}x\cdot \frac{3{x}^{2}}{8}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}\frac{3{x}^{3}}{8}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={[\frac{3{x}^{4}}{32}]}_{0}^{2} \\  & =\frac{48}{32}-\frac{0}{32} \\  & =\frac{3}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
